fusions.name: Clean Pair of Heels
fusions.desc: Kicks out at every enemy within 2 tiles for 11 damage, knocking each back 3 tiles. For 3 seconds after, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Stern Chaser
fusions.desc: Looses a bolt at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Startled Offing
fusions.desc: Dashes 6 tiles in the direction you are facing, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sail Ho
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that failed is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
